data.name: Verbal Instruction
data.description: You can use the aid another action to assist %1 allies within 30 feet on a skill or ability check. The ally must be able to hear and understand your instructions. If all allies are not engaged in the same task, using this ability is a full-round action rather than a standard action.|VerbalInstructionAllies
